args.summary:
Built a 2D spine-beam model of the three-span cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete box girder bridge (30+45+30 m, bearing centre-lines; deck 12.5 m wide).

Structure: spine_beam_2d, system continuous_on_piers (piers modelled, both with column geometry). Girder: single-cell cast_box, section integrated A=7.05 m², I=4.7775 m⁴, C55 → Ec=35500 MPa, γ=26 kN/m³, w=183.3 kN/m, m=18.685 t/m (self-weight only).

Supports (bearings in parallel per line, count 2): abutment 0 and abutment 3 PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric (400×500, 5×11 mm, Ge=1.2 MPa) → longitudinal free, Kh=0, Kv=3.614e6 kN/m; pier 1 plain laminated elastomeric fixed (600×700, 7×11 mm) → longitudinal spring, Kh=13090.9 kN/m, Kv=8.974e6 kN/m; pier 2 PTFE sliding (550×650, 6×11 mm) → longitudinal free, Kh=0, Kv=8.075e6 kN/m. Shape factors S: 10.101, 14.685, 13.542, 10.101.

Piers (twin circular columns, C40, Ec=32500 MPa, base fixed): pier 1 h=6 m, pier 2 h=29 m; A=3.0788 m², I=0.37715 m⁴ each (two columns combined).

Live load: Highway Class I, one-way, 3 design lanes (ξ=0.78), qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk = 320/350/320 kN for spans 30/45/30 m. Fundamental vertical frequency f1=3.239 Hz → impact factor μ=0.192.

Results: self-weight reactions 1811/7843/7735/1858 kN; max lane positive moment 11254 kN·m (mid-span 2), max negative moment −8975 kN·m (support 1). All L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
